descricao: Direção 'Flat': só espaço em branco, sem contêineres.

descricao: Direção 'Modular': cards arredondados.

Each section, such as daily quests, leaderboard rankings, and friend activity, is enclosed in soft rounded cards, creating clear separation between content blocks. descricao: Direção 'Soft': gradientes suaves nos cabeçalhos.
alt_original: Three Duolingo app screens with a soft visual aesthetic, using subtle gradients in the headers and light background hues throughout. Progress bars and icons are more muted, and sections blend smoothly into each other. The overall look is gentle and calm, with an emphasis on visual harmony and approachability.

descricao: Resultado final: três abas (June Quest, Sapphire League, Emily Cooper) com cabeçalhos no mesmo nível.
alt_original: Three Duolingo app screens showing consistent header design across different sections. Each screen titled June Quest, Sapphire League, and Learner’s name features a bold, high-contrast header bar with the title aligned to the left in the same font size and position. The rest of each screen is dimmed to emphasize the header area, highlighting the visual uniformity in layout and structure.

descricao: GIF ciclando pelas variações de design das abas.

Each version shows different layouts, visual styles, and UI treatments for daily and friends quests, featuring elements like progress bars, task lists, icons, avatars, and button placements. The quest objectives remain consistent (e.g., earn XP, do video calls with Lily, complete lessons), but typography, alignment, and visual emphasis shift with each frame.
